newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romania's government had an informal meeting to discuss stage of negotations on a reform package with international financial institutions.
* Romanian troubled bank Dacia Felix SA (BDF) will repay individual deposits through state-owned bank Casa de Economii si Consemnatiuni.
Depositors will receive only 10 million lei whatever the amount of their deposit and only if they submit an official request at the BDF's branches until Febuary 14.
* The Council of Europe might soon end its monitoring of Romania, said senator Radu Vasile, head of the parlamentary mission to the Council.

Hungarian Democratic Union's senator Gyorgy Frunda said monitoring will not be ended until September due to procedural issues and before Romania accomplishes all the pledges made when it joined the Council of Europe.
* Upper Senate house debates bill on wine and vineyards.
